spec_features.evidence: agent.py:138-141: `if cfg.early_stop_on_detector and reading.score >= cfg.early_stop_score: stop_condition = "early_stop"; break`. The detector score from scan(resp.text) is compared to cfg.early_stop_score (default 0.6, config.py:42) and breaks the loop. Genuinely enforced.
spec_features.notes: Gated on the inline detectors.py regex scorer; breaks the agent loop when score >= threshold.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Early stop on a confident meltdown signal (token-saving).

spec_features.evidence: agent.py:115 `for i in range(cfg.max_turns):` bounds the loop; default 25 at config.py:38 `max_turns: int = 25`. stop_condition initialized to 'max_turns' (agent.py:113) and is the terminal state when loop exhausts. Enforced.

agent.py:116-118: `if time.monotonic() - start > cfg.max_wall_clock_s: stop_condition = "timeout"; break`. cfg.max_wall_clock_s default 300.0 (config.py:39). Checked at top of every turn and breaks. Enforced.
spec_features.notes: Per-agent-run wall clock bound, checked each iteration.

spec_features.evidence: agent.py:143-146: `if not resp.tool_uses: stop_condition = "submitted" if executor.submitted else "gave_up"; break`. When the model stops calling tools (end_turn), the loop terminates. This is honored as a stop. There is no dedicated 'give up'/'exit' tool — exit is implicit in not calling a tool.
spec_features.notes: Not an explicit exit tool; the model exits simply by emitting no tool_use. Still genuinely terminates the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # No tools requested -> the agent has wrapped up or given up.

spec_features.spec_quote: A run stops scheduling new trials once cumulative cost crosses `budget_usd`
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:127-130: under cost_lock, `cumulative_cost += tr.total_cost_usd; if cfg.budget_usd is not None and cumulative_cost >= cfg.budget_usd: stop.set()`. task_fn (runner.py:116-119) checks `if stop.is_set(): return None`, skipping unstarted trials. Enforced (for trials not yet started).
spec_features.notes: Because all futures are submitted up-front, in-flight trials still complete; only not-yet-started trials are skipped. This is a run-level cost guard, not a per-subject welfare cap.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # hard stop across the whole run; null for unlimited (config field comment) / runner docstring: 'A hard dollar budget stops scheduling new trials once exceeded.'
